status: One attainable unquantized supervised reference. Registered before the new raw control, fit or development scores. Not an information ceiling: only linear site effects and oriented within-face pair/triple nonlinearities beyond the fixed packing ensemble, not all cross-face or high-order interactions. No other geometry, model search or tuned control.
roles: Physical banks: only new spatial-cycle fit=2048, dev=512, eligible.npy and rosters.npz. Equal weight per eligible native patch. Nested fit prefixes of the issued roster (512,2048), not selected by outcomes; parent remains the sampling unit. Never read a previous cycle fit, exam, transfer or score. Fixed anchored patch orientation, 386 signed vacancy sites at R=4; 49 little-endian bytes. No word, location, label or parent input to predictor. No simulation or paid call.
offset: Reuse cycle_models.packing_fit,packing_logits,signed_sites,summarize_shells/first boundary_models.D columns; no parameter changes. Exact Jeffreys stratum intercept, registered equal-residual-logit blend of conventional plus signed-site logistic and gradient-boosted conventional features. Sort all eligible native fit parent ids, shuffle PCG64(260405), alternate halves for both nuisance and packing crossfit. Deploy nuisance/packing refit on all eligible rows of the same prefix. Save each fit offset tuple (parent,anchor ordinal,stratum,stratum_oof,packing_oof) and full deployment object. All arms receive identical offset, not a separately tuned baseline. A stand-alone packing score already uses the complete sitewise linear input.
residual: Hard Bernoulli logistic residual at the fixed OOF packing logit, no extra fitted intercept. Features = 386 signed oriented sites (2*vacancy-1) then 24 tangent signatures: axis z,y,x, face -4,+4, tangent axis increasing physical index omitting normal, order 2 then 3. Subtract the row mean across all 386 signed sites, multiply each contiguous face-tangent pair/triple along that axis, average over all valid starts in that face. Population center/scale only those 24 columns on the fit prefix with SD floor 1e-6. Mean negative Bernoulli log likelihood + half squared norm weighted .5 on signed sites and .02 on motifs. More shrinkage for the already modeled 386 location terms. No hyperparameter/attenuation selected on dev.
updates: Zero coefficients. SGD with individual parent-independent eligible-row reshuffles (PCG64 seed 260511 or 260512); batch 512 including final partial batch before reshuffling; step t=0,...,511 uses eta=.20*(1+t/64)^(-.75). Evaluate fixed checkpoints after 256/512 updates, two seeds and their equal probability ensemble. Primary=full 2048, 512 updates, equal probability ensemble; no score-based selector or extrapolation across seeds. Clip every reported probability to [1e-7,1-1e-7].
positive_control: One end-to-end analytic conditional plant. PCG64(260513), 384 pseudo-parents, 32 patches each, first 256 fit, last 128 held. One parent vacancy probability Q~Uniform(.20,.30); all 386 bits independent Bernoulli(Q) conditional on Q; all shells synthetic, no physical labels. Two equiprobable strata S, shared nuisance logit -2.35+.70*S. Density packing effect .45*(mean(vacancy)-.25)/.05. Residual oriented tangent anisotropy: for each row f=(q(-z,y)-q(-z,x))/(sqrt(2)*.75/sqrt(72)), where q is row-centered signed-site contiguous pair mean on the -z face. Plant logit = nuisance + density effect + .45*f, independent Bernoulli outcomes. Generate in order: parent Q, all u(0,1) shell entries, stratum via integers(2), u(0,1) outcome draws. Same feature extraction, OOF pipeline, seeds/updates, hard proper scores, whole-parent intervals. Numeric central difference (step 1e-6 all parameters, float64, max absolute error<1e-6) of regularized loss. Pass iff error bound and both held ensemble(512)-packing and ensemble(512)-stratum parent 95% lower bounds exceed .001 and both point estimates exceed .001 + projected MDE(1024 parents, conservatively keeping 32 patches). No second plant or retuning on failure. Record plant's conditional noise/oracle expected packing-channel contrast for context, not physical sensitivity guarantee.
physical_decision: Dev (without adjusting model) report absolute stratum/packing/raw hard-label scores and paired raw-packing,raw-stratum,packing-stratum with parent ratio-of-sums Student 95% interval; 80%-power MDE=2.80*SE and projection to 1024 independent parents (same composition/variance assumption). Feasible signal and escalation gate: exact support plus BOTH full-primary gains >=.001 + projected paired MDE, and projected raw-packing MDE <=.001. Release only under parent decision; no physical assessment or paid scale by this trainer; this gate does not preclude a separate bounded CPU label-free diagnostic. Cold material superiority (if later authorized): both paired lower bounds >.001. Retain anchors>=25%, positives>=50%, each eligible outcome present in >=128 parents. Support failure stops physical model claims; do not alter overlap. Table of nested parent sizes, matched update doublings, paired seed ranges, empirical ascent, parent-paired last-minus-first update changes. Signed gain, especially packing-stratum, distinguishes predictable ordinary packing from incremental raw improvement. A weak or capped slope is not a universal physical null.
resource_admission: Single native BLAS/OpenMP/numexpr thread, local CPU only. Time feature generation, same baseline 2 held folds+full refit, raw updates and scoring on the one plant. Before physical, project from measured stages for 512 and 2048 fit and 512 dev, using conservative all-128-anchors eligible upper and a stated nominal overlap; allow margin for nonlinear optimizer iterations, do not call an estimate a hard timeout. Fit and dev require fresh public release and parent authorization. No simulated physical states or new expenditure. No launch across the discovery cutoff.
inference_api: spatial_raw.predict(model,shell,stratum) -> float64 [N,3] = stratum, packing, primary equal-probability raw; no labels. Use joblib.load on raw-model-{prefix}.joblib or load(path). packing_offsets(model,shell,stratum) -> pair of unbounded frozen logits. raw-oof-{prefix}.npz keys parent,anchor,stratum,stratum_oof,packing_oof, aligned in bank row-major eligible order. Here anchor = ordinal 0..127 within bank parent (not spatial location).
